summary: The milestone completed 12 experiments in 1.9 minutes, including 8 compute-bound experiments. The longest listed compute-bound experiment took 0.48 minutes, and the available data does not attribute its duration to a specific phase.
bottlenecks_identified: Disk-modification-time reconstruction and coarse duration reporting do not provide phase-level causes for the compute-bound runtime ordering.
The supplied data does not record concurrent model count or runner selection, so it cannot establish whether any workload qualified for multi-GPU dispatch.
improvements_suggested: Instrument launch, model loading, inference, shutdown, and reconciliation with monotonic clocks under one experiment identifier.
Sample device utilization, memory, and process identity throughout each compute-bound experiment and join those samples to its timing trace.
Log requested and loaded model counts with the dispatcher choice, and use both GPUs only for eligible concurrent-model work.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Produce one monotonic stage timeline for every compute-bound experiment.
Tag continuous device and process samples with the active experiment identifier.
Persist loaded-model count and dispatcher choice before inference begins.
meta_reflection: The data supports a non-idle compute classification but not a milestone-wide utilization grade or a causal explanation of the compute durations. No data available this milestone establishes a task with at least two models loaded concurrently, so no missed DualGPURunner engagement can be claimed.
